english.note: This is the all-purpose term for an item kept or given to remember an event or place.
Choose this when the remembrance is a physical keepsake or souvenir kept to remind someone of a person or event.

examples.english: This souvenir is something I received on my graduation day.
examples.traditional: 呢件紀念品係我喺畢業禮嗰日收到嘅。

examples.english: I bought my mum a remembrance from the trip.
examples.traditional: 我喺旅行嗰陣買咗個紀念品畀阿媽。
